capabilities: Open a block handle menu to convert blocks and insert content
Drag blocks and list items to reorder, nest, and drop into quotes or callouts
Move, copy, link, or embed blocks between notes side by side
Apply text and background colors, select whole blocks, and copy block links
Customize which menu commands appear, their grouping, and their order
disambiguation: Not an integration with Notion; it only adds Notion-style block interactions to Obsidian's editor.
extras: Desktop-only and requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or later; works only in Live Preview, not in source mode or on mobile. Runs locally with no network requests or telemetry.
intentEvidence: Edit, rearrange, and reuse Markdown blocks in Obsidian's Live Preview editor.
problem: Obsidian's Live Preview has no block handles for dragging, converting, or reusing blocks the way Notion does, so rearranging structure and moving blocks between notes requires manual text editing.
summary: Notion-style block editing for Live Preview: a drag handle and block menu to convert, reorder, nest, and move or embed Markdown blocks across notes.
